name: menu
style: sea shanty, folk, rousing male choir, deep male lead vocal, fiddle, accordion, stomping drum, hand claps, 100 BPM, adventurous, tavern singalong
lyrics:
[verse]
Oh the wind blows cold off the Grey Isle shore
And the powder's dry and the guns are four
We'll sail her out where the pirates roam
And we'll bring the gold and the captain home

[chorus]
Haul away, boys, haul away
Broadside thunder and the open bay
Haul away, boys, haul away
We'll be rich men on the judgement day

[verse]
There's a light that burns on Lantern Rock
And a widow waits at the Greywater dock
There's ice in the north and fire in the east
And a fortune waits in the belly of the beast

[chorus]
Haul away, boys, haul away
Broadside thunder and the open bay
Haul away, boys, haul away
We'll be rich men on the judgement day

name: port
style: tavern sea shanty, folk, warm male vocal, small crowd singing along, fiddle, tin whistle, bodhran, accordion, 108 BPM, cheerful, cosy, drinking song
lyrics:
[verse]
Put in at the harbour and tie her up fast
The tavern is warm and the storm is past
There's rum for the thirsty and stew for the cold
And a song for the sailor who comes home with gold

[chorus]
So fill up the tankard and stamp on the floor
We sail in the morning, but sing a while more
Fill up the tankard and drink to the sea
She takes what she pleases, but tonight we are free

[verse]
The keeper is laughing, the fiddler's in tune
The harbourmaster's counting by the light of the moon
The shipwright is swearing he'll have her by dawn
So drink while you're able, tomorrow we're gone

[chorus]
So fill up the tankard and stamp on the floor
We sail in the morning, but sing a while more
Fill up the tankard and drink to the sea
She takes what she pleases, but tonight we are free

name: port_2
style: slow sea shanty, folk ballad, female lead vocal, gentle male harmonies, fiddle, acoustic guitar, accordion, 84 BPM, wistful, warm, tavern at night
lyrics:
[verse]
My love sailed out on a morning tide
With the wind in his sails and the sea so wide
He swore he'd come back when the summer was through
But the summers are many and the letters are few

[chorus]
Light the lamp in the window, keep the fire low
The sea gives back what she's willing to show
Light the lamp in the window, and sing it slow
For the ones who sailed where the cold winds blow

[verse]
The sailors come in with their stories and rum
They tell me of storms and the wars they have won
I pour them their drinks and I listen for one
Who'll tell me he's seen him, beyond the setting sun

[chorus]
Light the lamp in the window, keep the fire low
The sea gives back what she's willing to show
Light the lamp in the window, and sing it slow
For the ones who sailed where the cold winds blow
